mechanical_amendment: R3 stopped after the first MLEvolve search completed six candidates and 20 Codex calls, before candidate replay, its paired Vanilla arm, any terminal arm receipt, or private-test access. The failure was an SSH/SCP connection timeout caused by opening multiple connections per candidate dispatch. R3.1 streams upload, execution, result download, and exact cleanup through one SSH connection, validated by a 4-job 32-CPU canary and 10/10 sequential dispatch soak. The consumed pc1 task is excluded and replaced before source retrieval by madelon (OpenML data ID 1485). R3's node-specific replay binding and all budgets, endpoints, and verdict thresholds remain unchanged.
purpose: Admission screen for incremental search value over the same strong Codex model; not an algorithm-superiority or product-readiness claim.

quality_verdicts.MLEVOLVE_SEARCH_VALUE_ADMIT: all 9 pairs valid; at least 8 practical wins; median final normalized delta > 0.01; one-sided exact sign-test p < 0.05
quality_verdicts.MLEVOLVE_SEARCH_VALUE_CONDITIONAL_ADMIT: all 9 pairs valid; at least 6 practical wins; median final normalized delta > 0.01; ADMIT not reached
quality_verdicts.MLEVOLVE_SEARCH_VALUE_REJECT_FOR_INTEGRA: all 9 pairs valid and either at least 6 practical losses or median final normalized delta <= 0
quality_verdicts.WAVE_NOT_EVALUABLE: any task pair missing, invalid, overwritten, test-evaluated early, or outside frozen budget

authority.test_access: Test labels are inaccessible to both arms and are scored once only after all 18 arms have terminal receipts.
authority.no_replacement: A failed or unavailable frozen task is not replaced; the wave becomes WAVE_NOT_EVALUABLE.
authority.claim_ceiling: One run per task supports a heterogeneous admission screen only; it does not separate within-task agent stochasticity or establish general algorithm superiority.
